name: type-badge
title: TypeBadge
description: A column's data type as a glyph and a short name in its data.type.* colour, for grid headers, column nodes and the value viewer.
usage: Use TypeBadge wherever a column's type is shown: the schema tree's column nodes, a table of columns, the value viewer, the DataGrid's headers. type picks the family (integer, decimal, text, boolean, datetime, json, binary, uuid); label shows the real type ("numeric(12,2)"); iconOnly keeps only the glyph where space is tight. For a status word use Badge.

props.name: type
props.description: The type family and its data.type.* colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Text after the glyph; defaults to the short name (int, dec, text, bool, time, json, bin, uuid).

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Only the glyph; the name becomes hidden text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: data-slot="type-badge", data-type; text.code-sm in the type colour.

slots.name: glyph
slots.description: The glyph in a thin frame of the type colour, aria-hidden; data-slot="type-badge-glyph".

accessibility: The glyph is aria-hidden; the type name is text (hidden text with iconOnly), so screen readers read "int" or "numeric(12,2)".
Each family has its own glyph and name, so the type is never conveyed by colour alone.
Long type names truncate; put the full name in title where it may be cut.
